reviewed_by: Codex review of slim release preparation and the one installed-Core smoke
reason: Release preparation now has three jobs and one packaged-Core Chromium journey. Select the exact driver, receipt, and workflow-shape contracts plus the single real-Core pairing, project, chat, and reload case. The Python contracts verify a failed or absent smoke receipt blocks finalization and that diagnostics are manual only. The browser case proves the operator journey against disposable LAN Core; the release job repeats it against the installed DEB and embedded UI.
exclusions: No product UI, API, or Rust behavior changed. Frontend unit and native tests are empty. Broad Playwright, sandbox, packaging, crash cleanup, tampered-signature, and Debian/Kali checks are intentionally moved to optional manual diagnostics. The local browser run uses source Core and a candidate production bundle; an installed artifact, signature, and provenance are verified by a later authorized release candidate, not this branch run.
